header.purpose: Intent labels for every unique recorded J1 customer turn; consumed by tests/test_mock_intent_corpus.py
header.label_definitions: intent: exactly one of question | correction | selection | confirm | decline. A mixed turn is labeled by the part the mock must not get wrong: a turn that asks a question while also naming details is a question (the mock must not stage the details); a turn that both accepts and changes something is a correction. actionable: the card (last four), the option label or dollar amount, and the payment date (ISO) the mock may act on from this turn; all null for any question. negated: cards (last four) or option labels the turn names but rejects.
